Thank you to everyone who has played Valor Mortis! We’ve added new critical attacks for the Rapier and Saber and to celebrate the spooky season, we've also added new themed weapon skins. These will be available to all players once they install today’s update. We appreciate your support as we continue to make this game the best it can be!

On the quality of life side, we’ve implemented further improvements to help address stuttering and fixed a variety of issues that you’ve reported. Keep letting us know if you’re running into any issues and don’t forget to submit your crash reports!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746684/e69ce61cd76af46cd10a604568ae3acbe078b18b.gif"]
New weapon skins for melee and ranged weapons
New critical attacks for the Rapier and Saber
Improvements to help mitigate stuttering and improve FPS, for PC players, you may need to recreate your shader cache.
Fixed an edge case where some players who died at the same time as bosses may have been missing the achievements/trophies for them. These should now unlock when pressing Continue on the main menu.
Fixed an issue in The Quarry on Chapter 2 where players could get stuck when trying to mantle onto the tower
Tweaked a respawn position in Chapter 2 so that players don’t get stuck in an infinite falling loop if they knocked out a platform while standing on it
Fixed a few areas across the game where players could wedge themselves into places and get stuck
Fixed a bug that could cause players to get stuck in the Options menu
Fixed a bug where in Chapter 5, some voiceover and subtitles could break if the player fast traveled at the wrong time
Fixed an issue where the mine cart might not save correctly when finishing the sequence in Chapter 4
Adjusted the outdated drivers popup to now show up on handhelds that may have the latest driver set
Fixed a bug where the player's arms could detach on certain critical attacks
Fixed a bug where the camera could reset incorrectly after using the Pull ability
Fixed additional edge case issues on bosses where progression could be blocked if the player and boss died at the same time
Fixed a bug where Stasis could persist on The Orphan
Fixed a bug where Fire Transmutations might not stop being used from spawned enemies in The Entity fight
Fixed a bug where The Entity shield could be in the wrong position
Fixed a bug where Raphael could stop attacking if he got staggered by a Rapier heavy attack at the right moment
Fixed a bug where The Bride could get stuck teleporting if hit with the rapier at the exact moment it ended

items.text: Here's a brand new patch with many improvements and fixes!

We've adjusted enemy hitboxes and damage windows based on your feedback. Please let us know if you feel like the overall experience has improved after trying this update. More patches are in the works and we'll share those when they're ready!
If you still encounter issues, such as if your progression has been soft locked, you can contact our Support Team who can provide replacement save files at each Chapter of the game.
Adjusted attack hitboxes for many enemies and bosses to better match their animations. This should prevent the feeling that attacks are hitting players when they appear to visually miss
Tuned damage windows for several enemy attacks, including Risen Duelist, Eternal Guardsman, Howler, and others, which should improve hit consistency
Improved the readability of attack windups for the Risen Sapeur’s push attack and the Risen Lancer’s unblockable red attack, making it more clear when they are coming

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements

items.text: Fixed a bug with the Dual Sword Volunteer where combos could be interrupted by level terrain
Fixed a bug where players could be permanently slowed down and unable to jump if they were crouching while getting hit
Fixed a bug where players could have Burning status permanently applied after respawn
Fixed multiple crashes
Fixed a bug where upgrading your Ferrofluid Flask may not be saved
Fixed GPU driver popup behavior to clarify language and make it less intrusive
Cleaned up an area in The Quarry where players could get stuck on level terrain
Fixed a bug where animations could appear in slow motion
Fixed a bug where Volunteers could keep their Stasis visuals active indefinitely
Fixed a rare bug where the Player might not be able to land on the platform after picking up Pistol in Chapter 2
Fixed a bug where Steam Deck and SteamOS could prompt players to update drivers despite being on latest
Note: players must return to the side quest location to start/complete these quests, these fixes won’t make the side quests appear or resolve in your quest log automatically
Sleeping Beauty - Fixed an issue where the letter could not be visible
Misericorde - Fixed an issue where players could miss the start point for the side quest
In the Name of Art - Fixed an issue that could prevent the quest from being started
Note: for any players who ended up in a state where they were unable to progress past a boss due to dying at the same time, these fixes should work retroactively
The Iron Marshall
Fixed a bug where the player could end up stuck if the boss was killed at the exact same time as that the player died
Fixed a bug where he could spin to face a different direction while killed
Fixed a bug where the boss could fall through the floor if he was killed by a grenade
Sphinx, Devourer of the Unworthy
Fixed a bug where the Sphinx audio could be muted during the boss fight after pausing
Fixed a bug where the Sphinx boss occasionally stopped attacking when staggered by fire
The Slaughtermill
Fixed a camera locking issue that could occur during the first phase
Fixed a phase transition issue that occasionally occurred if the player pulled the doors during the Windpush attack
Anna, The Bride Drowned in Tears
Fixed multiple bugs where the boss could stop attacking in different circumstances
Fixed an issue where she could disappear after teleporting
Removed the ability to easily defeat her if standing on a certain rock pile
High Justicar Aurelius, Last of the Faithful
Fixed a bug where the boss stops attacking
Fixed a bug where the battle ended after the first phase
The Orphan
Fixed a bug where the boss occasionally disappeared during its transformation cutscene
Fixed a bug where the boss could have stasis VFX persist across phases
Captain Raphael of the Nephtis Superioris
Tweaked boss balance to adjust his ability to block/stagger
Adjusted the strafe, walk, and shoot speed to make them more consistent
Fixed a bug that could cause the boss to slide around the level floor
Fixed a bug that blocked progression if the player and boss die at the same time
The Entity, Voice of the Void
Fixed a bug where Flame Transmutations effect could persist on the boss’ “recruited bosses”
Fixed a bug where the boss’s Claymore could appear to float in the air
Fixed a bug where, in rare circumstances, he could vanish when being aimed during teleport
Fixed multiple bugs regarding stasis transmutation application, behavior, and persistence
Fixed a bug where the boss could occasionally walk and attack at the same time
Fixed a bug that could occasionally have him aim and shoot at nothing

After we put our hearts and souls into this game, it's been incredible to see people playing. Making a first-person game like this was a big risk, and we're glad that despite the challenges, many of you think that we've pulled it off!
Since launch earlier this week, we've been working as hard as we can to make the game better. We have a first round of bug fixes and optimization today, but there's a lot more to come.
If you are experiencing stutters and significant performance drops and you played the Playtest or the Demo, we recommend that you delete your game settings found here:
AppData\\Local\\ValorMortis\\Saved\\Config\\Windows\\GameUserSettings.ini
Fixed some of the most common crashes that we have seen across platforms
As a reminder, please always submit your crash reports and provide any additional info you can so we can keep chasing them down.
Added GPU driver detection: an automated pop-up will now show up to notify players that are using outdated graphics drivers.

This has been one of the areas where we are seeing players have the biggest performance and stability improvements. Please ensure that you are updating to the latest version of your respective GPU drivers!
Turned down error logging which could have minor performance impact in rare cases.

We are continuing to work on and investigate further performance issues that are being reported by some players. For those of you who played the Playtest or Demo, we recommend that you delete your game settings found here: AppData\\Local\\ValorMortis\\Saved\\Config\\Windows\\GameUserSettings.ini
Fixed an issue where the post-boss sequence was not saving progress correctly after defeating the boss and watching the cutscene on Chapter 4.
This should fix a blocker where in some rare cases, players were unable to progress following the fight.
Resolved a progression blocker on Chapter 12 and fixed a few edge cases where cutscenes may not trigger or unlock the next lantern.
Fixed an issue that could impact starting and progressing the sidequest “In the Name of Art” on Chapter 5.
Fixed a bug where the Volunteer enemies could stop attacking after being backstabbed while on patrol.
No more free Volunteer kills for you… 💀
Greetings Soldiers,

We have returned from Köln, where we engaged in an arduous campaign to brave the hills of the Rhein region and the great Bavarian hordes of gamescom. Our Eternal Guard stood tall, inspiring faith in Emperor Napoleon, as we recruited hundreds of new soldiers to Valor Mortis.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746684/a92a0981c491ea21b86f6b627b73aaee3b3c5072.jpg"]

We also unveiled a new look at the game unlike anything we’ve shown before. Our Story Trailer shows a glimpse at the narrative depth we are crafting in Valor Mortis. There aren’t many other survivors remaining, but each of them will play a pivotal role in determining William’s fate. Why can’t he remember his past? What is that beast in the sandy desert? Who is a friend and who is a foe? You’ll find all of these answers as you venture through the story of Valor Mortis on October 13.

notes.title: Last chance to play the Demo

items.text: Finally, the Steam Demo will go offline next week on September 8. Since releasing the Demo in June, we’ve made huge improvements to the full version of the game based on your feedback. But that also means the Demo is no longer very representative of the quality and polish we’ll have in the full release.

While the Demo levels are titled Chapter I and Chapter VII, they’re actually bespoke versions of those chapters that we recreated for Steam Next Fest. Therefore, it isn’t simple to implement the optimization improvements, finely tuned balancing, and bug fixes from the full game in the Demo version.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746684/aa457729a5c60fea441d76b80d1ae802f73e94b6.gif"]

One of the most common criticisms we’ve seen about the Demo is that General Lothaire is too unforgiving at the end of Chapter I. We feel that this is partly because players have only spent about 30 minutes in the game when they reach the end of Chapter I to fight him. That’s a short time to become accustomed to the first-person combat system, which is unique in the soulslike genre. In the full game, General Lothaire is intended as the boss at the end of Chapter II. By that point, you’ll have spent more time with the mechanics and leveled up your character, making the difficulty curve much smoother.
We are confident that the full game you’ll see on October 13 will be much better than what’s in the Demo, and we’re excited to show you how we’ve addressed your feedback!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746684/3053ce93837256154c277c8bddfaf5819f256eee.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746684/e3cb9071bdec7e9a0efd25cc93c510040f3c45cc.png"]

The response to our release date change has been incredible. It's going to be a crazy few months of gaming, but we believe we're creating something unique and distinct with our first-person soulslike. We appreciate that you want to join us on this journey!
Our team has been continuing to work on notable issues in the Demo based on your reports. Here's a few more fixes that we've managed to implement.
Fixed crash on loading Witch Hunt level
Fixed a crash that could occur when blood VFX would randomly get corrupted
Mitigated issue where audio could loop endlessly after killing certain enemies
Added more accurate GPU auto detection
Continued performance improvements across both levels

We have also started a Speedrunning section in our Discord server. The speedrunning community was great to our previous Ghostrunner games. Now that we've introduced platforming segments and movement mechanics, runners have already been achieving impressive results in the Demo. Leoninrus has already completed Chapter VII of the Demo in under 5 minutes.

Continue giving us your feedback! It has been extremely useful for resolving issues with the Demo, but it has also been helping us improve the full game. We want to make Valor Mortis a great, original experience in the soulslike genre and you have already been a big part of achieving that lofty goal.
Greetings Soldiers!

Your feedback continues to be super helpful in identifying issues and letting us fix bugs and crashes that you have experienced in the last few days. There's still more to do, but with your input, we've tackled some more of the most pertinent issues that you have brought up!
DLSS 4.5 and XeSS 3 and their accompanying technologies are now available for supported GPUs
Implemented a check for AMD FSR4 Frame Generation and AntiLag2 technologies to prevent potential issues by ensuring it's only usable on supported cards
Fixed crashes caused by excessive player events
Fixed crashes triggered by blocking enemy attacks in specific situations
Fixed player's character getting stuck after respawn
Fixed issue with skyboxes
Fixed blood VFX constantly playing on backstabbed enemies
Fixed player progression cap for demo
Fixed Mice dialogue being unavailable in certain scenarios
Fixed loading and shader compilation screens "jumping" at certain thresholds
NOTE: Because of the UE limitations, please restart the game after enabling Frame Generation

We've seen a number of reports of poor performance from players whose hardware should be able to run the game quite well. In the past, we've experienced poor perf on older Nvidia drivers. To this end, we we want to remind you to make sure you update your GPU drivers!

Hopefully, all of this will allow more of you to experience our game! We will continue to make improvements to the Demo and still have issues that we are tracking down. For the full list, please review the Known Issues thread. If you experience any crashes or bugs while playing, please submit the crash reports and leave feedback here on the forums.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746684/f49ea08652170403131f8988abd8bb1357c8c317.jpg"]
First of all, thank you so much for jumping into the Valor Mortis Demo. You’ve given us loads of helpful feedback that we have been working all day to address!

This first Hotfix targets a number of issues with the Demo’s stability and performance. These include crashes related to memory management, tutorial screens, and performance improvements at specific points in Chapter 1: Revival.
Fixed multiple crashes triggered by clearing old items from memory as players progress through each level
Fixed multiple crashes related to tutorial screens
Fixed some spots where players could get stuck in geometry or the environment on level one (Chapter 1: Revival)
Improved performance on environmental detail when moving through level one (Chapter 1: Revival)
Improved performance to the General Lothaire boss fight on level one (Chapter 1: Revival)
Adjusted Lantern interactions to be more consistent and stable across both levels

There are more issues that we are still working on. The most pertinent one is a crash that seems to occur for players using FSR with specific Nvidia GPUs. If you are using this setup and encounter a crash, please submit the logs through the crash reporter so we can continue to hunt it down. In the meantime, you can try using a different graphical setup.
Additionally, we have turned off ray tracing but are working on a fix to get it working again. We’ve listed a number of other Known Issues on this page in the Steam forums.

Overall, this is exactly why we wanted to release an early version of the game. With thousands of new players over the past day, we’ve seen several things that we need to work on as we head towards launch.

This game has been a big step forward for our studio and we hope that it also marks an innovative new direction for the soulslike genre. In some ways, it’s a big experiment and because of that, we can’t thank you enough for helping us along the way!

notes.title: Thanks for joining our playtest and sharing your feedback!

items.text: We have been working on the biggest issues and bugs that were causing consistent crashes. The new build today should fix some of them and you can read the details below.
Fixed several crashes related to corrupted save files,
Fire transmutation should no longer disappear from player's equipment,
Added additional checks to prevent save file corruption,
Changed position of the weapon change tutorial,
Fixed FSR Frame Generation being on by default (players that were affected by the issue may have to delete their old config file),
You can find the old config file C:\\Users\\ \\AppData\\Local\\Minotaur\\Saved\\Config\\Windows

You can join these community contests where we'll be giving away copies of the game at launch! This is one of the amazing screenshots by @pino44io. Speedrunners in Discord have managed to complete the level in under 6 minutes!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746684/f066ac1758bced57248e81eecff0832c36fba3e5.jpg"]

The fastest recorded speedrun of the playtest level will be crowned as Napoleon’s strongest soldier. To enter, players will need to record and post their speedrun somewhere where we and community moderators can confirm your time. This can be YouTube, Twitch Vod or another publicly accessible video hosting platform.
There will be categories for inbounds and out of bounds runs.
Speedrun submissions must be also linked to the Discord for tracking.
We will select winners who post fan art and screenshots. They can be posted to Steam, our Discord server, social media or Reddit to enter.
Discord - Must join the server and post to the contest channel
Social Media - must use #valormortis in a publicly visible post and follow the official Valor Mortis account. Twitter, Instagram, Bluesky, and TikTok are eligible.
Reddit - must post to r/valormortis and join the subreddit
